title: Export as TIFF
description: Writes frames of a stack to a TIFF file, a chunk at a time, each frame a page, as dev's imviewer exports a stack. A relative path is in the project's folder, and {field} tokens in it are the entity's values. Of a stack with channels or planes, one channel and plane are written.

path.title: File
path.description: Where the TIFF file is written; relative to the project's folder unless absolute.

lastFrame.title: Last frame
lastFrame.description: 0 for the last frame of the stack.
